hero.headline: Designed for everyday comfort, quiet privacy, and lasting confidence.
hero.subcopy: SHE-VALLEY is an accessible-premium women's innerwear and lifestyle platform built for Bangladesh—grounded in warm tactile tones, bilingual Bengali and English clarity, and mobile-first ergonomics.

storefront.heroHeadline: Quiet comfort crafted for every day.
storefront.heroSubcopy: Breathable combed cotton and beechwood modal essentials designed for Bangladesh's warm climate—delivered in plain, discreet packaging with Cash on Delivery.
storefront.categoriesSubtitle: Thoughtfully patterned silhouettes ready for daily wear, rest, and maternal care.

storefront.storyBody: Every SHE-VALLEY parcel leaves our fulfillment desk in neutral, unbranded packaging—zero product names or descriptions appear on the courier label. Pay effortlessly at your doorstep across all 64 districts.
storefront.trustPlainDesc: Unbranded outer parcel with zero product descriptions visible.
storefront.trustFitDesc: Gentle guidance on band, cup, and breathable natural fabrics.

pdp.sizeTip: Measure snugly around the ribcage for underbust and lightly over the fullest part for bust. If between band sizes, choose one band up for humid-weather ease.
pdp.shippingNote: Ships in plain, unbranded packaging. Dhaka Metro ৳70 · Sub-Dhaka ৳100 · Outside Dhaka ৳130 · Free delivery on orders ৳2,500+.
